question: What color is the stop sign?

query.interpretation: Final prompt/template token; not the question word or a decoded answer token

patch_order: CLIP row-major, CLS removed, no token permutation

preprocessing.overlay_source: Denormalized actual FP16 pixel_values; RGB rounded to uint8, not original image coordinates

definitions.query_accessible_keys: attention_mask != 0 and key_index <= query_index; no past cache
definitions.visual_attention_mass: Sum of original probabilities over accessible image-token keys
definitions.nonvisual_attention_mass: Sum over all other accessible keys, including BOS, role/template and query itself
definitions.visual_entropy_nats: -sum(p_visual*ln(p_visual)), p_visual=a_visual/M_visual; zero mass is flagged undefined
definitions.top10_visual_attention_mass: Original mass of largest ceil(0.1*N_visual)=58 patch weights, per head
definitions.layer_summary: Arithmetic mean and population SD over heads; mean(R_head) is not ratio(mean masses)
definitions.spatial_display: Head-mean raw patch probabilities / that layer's maximum; only display is scaled

timings_seconds.note: CUDA-synchronized forward only; CPU transfer/comparison/file IO are in total, not forward

memory.note: MiB; allocated/reserved peaks include resident model; driver process value is a sample, not a peak

limitations: Single image, two prompts, last template-token query, prefill only; descriptive attention, no causal information-flow claims

artifact_refresh.reason: Add per-head R plot with log color scale and log R curve; reuse saved raw statistics, no forward rerun
